title: ～なくてもいい — “you don’t have to ～”
summary: Says that it is not necessary to do the action. Drop い from the nai-form, add なくても, then いい.

patterns.form: 動詞ない形（−い）＋なくても＋いい
patterns.gloss: verb nai-form + なくてもいい

body.p: 靴を脱がなくてもいいです means you do not need to take off your shoes. It also reassures the listener.
来る → 来ない → 来なくても. Change the final い of the nai-form to くても.

body.h: Not the same as てもいい
body.p: てもいい gives permission. なくてもいい says it is unnecessary. 食べてもいい and 食べなくてもいい differ.

examples.ja: 明日（あした）は来（こ）なくてもいいです。
examples.romaji: Ashita wa konakute mo ii desu.
examples.tr: You don't have to come tomorrow.

examples.ja: 靴（くつ）を脱（ぬ）がなくてもいいです。
examples.romaji: Kutsu o nuganakute mo ii desu.
examples.tr: You don't have to take off your shoes.

examples.ja: 今日（きょう）は宿題（しゅくだい）をしなくてもいいです。
examples.romaji: Kyō wa shukudai o shinakute mo ii desu.
examples.tr: You don't have to do homework today.

pitfalls: It is not a prohibition. It means “no need to,” not “don’t.”
The last part can be replaced with 大丈夫.
